title: Minimal APIs vs Controllers in ASP.NET Core

scenes.say: Should you use minimal APIs or controllers in your next ASP.NET Core project? Let's break it down.

scenes.label: Minimal
scenes.sub: Define endpoints with less code in Program.cs
scenes.say: Minimal APIs, introduced in .NET 6, let you define HTTP endpoints directly in Program dot C S with almost no boilerplate.

scenes.label: Controller
scenes.say: Controllers are part of the Model View Controller pattern. They add structure, filters, and conventions for bigger projects.
Minimal APIs are quick and concise, perfect for small services. Controllers help organize and scale complex applications.

scenes.question: Are minimal APIs always better?
scenes.right: No. Minimal APIs suit small apps, but controllers are better for complex projects.
scenes.say: Interview trap: Are minimal APIs always the best choice? Not really. Use controllers for bigger, complex systems.
